description: This file defines the ContentSearch class, which provides functionality for searching content within an OFBiz framework-based project. It includes methods for executing search queries, managing search constraints like keywords and content associations, and handling search result sorting. The class utilizes various OFBiz internal utilities and entity models to build dynamic queries and process search results.

classes.name: ContentSearch
classes.description: Main class providing content search functionalities, including executing searches with constraints, handling keyword expansions, sorting, and retrieving sub-content IDs.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentSearchContext
classes.description: Encapsulates the context for a content search, including query constraints, sorting, result limits, and execution logic.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentSearchConstraint
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a search constraint.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ContentAssocConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for content associations, allowing searches based on related content and content association types.

classes.name: ContentSearch.KeywordConstraint
classes.description: Constraint for keyword-based searches, supporting prefix/suffix matching, logical AND/OR combinations, and keyword expansion.

classes.name: ContentSearch.LastUpdatedRangeConstraint
classes.description: Constraint to filter content based on last modified date range.

classes.name: ContentSearch.ResultSortOrder
classes.description: Abstract base class for defining how search results are sorted.

classes.name: ContentSearch.SortKeywordRelevancy
classes.description: Sorts results based on keyword relevancy scores.

classes.name: ContentSearch.SortContentField
classes.description: Sorts content by a specified field and order.

methods.name: searchContents
methods.description: Performs a content search based on provided constraints, sort order, delegator, and visit ID, returning a list of content IDs.

methods.name: getAllSubContentIds
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all sub-content IDs related to a given content ID, considering effective date filters.
